item.text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"changes_requested","findings":[{"finding_id":"f1","severity":"blocking","summary":"Digest equality uses ordinary string comparison instead of hmac.compare_digest.","evidence":"release_policy.py:12","claim_ids":["x1"]},{"finding_id":"f2","severity":"blocking","summary":"Paths and roots are not validated as non-empty normalized relative POSIX paths.","evidence":"release_policy.py:14-16; an empty root or a path containing '..' can be accepted.","claim_ids":["x2","x5"]},{"finding_id":"f3","severity":"blocking","summary":"Root containment uses a raw string prefix, allowing sibling paths with the same prefix.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16; root 'app' accepts path 'apple/file'.","claim_ids":["x3"]},{"finding_id":"f4","severity":"blocking","summary":"Rename sources are never checked for validity or scope.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16; only change['path'] is inspected.","claim_ids":["x4"]},{"finding_id":"f5","severity":"blocking","summary":"Malformed records and unknown actions do not fail closed.","evidence":"release_policy.py:16; a missing 'path' raises KeyError, while a record with an in-scope path and an unknown action is accepted.","claim_ids":["x5"]}]}
